summary: The daemon (daemon.js) is an HTTP server that manages a per-workspace task graph layered on top of Claude Code's native task files. The overlay (lib/overlay.js) stores cross-session edges, richer statuses, and decision notes that survive beyond native task retention. The MCP layer (lib/mcp-core.js, mcp-graph.js) exposes the graph as Claude tools — both via stdio (for Claude Code) and via the daemon's /mcp endpoint (for custom connectors). A knowledge base (lib/embed.js, lib/judge.js) records scored verdicts from every task completion and surfaces them as context for future related work, forming a self-learning loop.

The daemon (daemon.js) is an HTTP server that manages a per-workspace task graph layered on top of Claude Code's native task files. The overlay (lib/overlay.js) stores cross-session edges, richer statuses, and decision notes that survive beyond native task retention. The MCP layer (lib/mcp-core.js, mcp-graph.js) exposes the graph as Claude tools — both via stdio (for Claude Code) and via the daemon's /mcp endpoint (for custom connectors). A knowledge base (lib/embed.js, lib/judge.js) records scored verdicts from every task completion and surfaces them as context for future related work, forming a self-learning loop.
